tools.name: gridwatch_preflight
tools.description: Paid read-only endpoint preflight for autonomous agents. Makes one outbound HTTP request and returns reachability, status, latency, risk flags, SHA-256 evidence and an x402 payment route. Use before an agent depends on or pays an unfamiliar endpoint.

tools.name: gridextract_markdown
tools.description: Paid read-only web extraction for agents. Fetches one public web URL and returns bounded clean text plus evidence hash and receipt metadata. Use when an agent needs compact machine-readable page content.

tools.name: gridverify_evidence
tools.description: Paid read-only evidence verification. Probes one public URL and returns verdict, operational risk flags, content type, timestamp and SHA-256 evidence. Use before trusting externally supplied web evidence.

tools.name: griddata_domain
tools.description: Paid read-only domain intelligence. Resolves current public DNS A-record data and returns timestamped hashed evidence. Use when an agent needs current domain/DNS evidence without maintaining its own resolver.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gridextract_markdown, gridverify_evidence · Private data: griddata_domain · Public sink: gridwatch_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gridextract_markdown, gridverify_evidence · Private data: griddata_domain · Public sink: gridwatch_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
